devices.checksOn: On: your computers accept only devices added to this account, so even a compromised server can’t control them.
devices.checksOff: Off: your computers trust the account password alone.
devices.offText: Your computers will then trust the account password alone: anyone who has it, or anyone who controls the server, can control your computers directly. Device approvals stay.
devices.onlyAdded: Only a device that has been added can change this setting. Please try again.
devices.allowAISub: AI clients can see the screen, use the mouse and keyboard, run commands, and read and write files
devices.aiOnText: The AI clients you approved will be able to use this computer as you: see the screen, use the mouse and keyboard, run commands, and read and write files. While one does, the computer and your sessions show it. Turn it off here at any time, or press Stop at the computer.
devices.allowAdminSub: Windows: the signed-in user must be an administrator. Mac: confirmed at the Mac each time
devices.addAISub: Let AI clients such as Claude Code control the computers you allow
devices.aiOld: This computer's Deskway is too old for AI control. Update it on that computer to use it.
audit.stopped: AI control stopped at the computer
aiclient.title: Add an AI client
aiclient.lead: Send the prompt below to your AI client (Claude Code, Cursor and others). It downloads, installs and signs in by itself. Your password is never needed.
aiclient.s1: Copy the prompt and send it to the AI
aiclient.s1Sub: The AI downloads the program for the system it runs on, checks it, and installs it in the user folder, without administrator rights.
aiclient.copyFailed: The browser did not let this page copy. Show all, then select and copy it yourself.
aiclient.noFiles: The server has no AI client programs yet. Once the administrator puts the built programs in the server's clients folder, the prompt can be copied here.
aiclient.s2Sub: When the AI signs in, it tells you 6 digits. The request shows here at the same time: approve it if the digits match.
aiclient.idle: Copying the prompt starts 10 minutes of waiting for the AI to sign in.
aiclient.waiting: Waiting for the AI to sign in · {time} left
aiclient.waitNote: For 10 minutes after you copy the prompt, this account accepts new AI sign-ins; at other times they are refused.
aiclient.ended: The 10 minutes are over: new AI sign-ins are refused. To go on, copy the prompt again.
aiclient.match: Approve only if the AI told you the same digits
aiclient.s3: Choose the computers the AI may control
aiclient.s3Sub: The AI can use only computers with Allow AI control on. Turn it on or off in My devices at any time.
aiclient.manual: Connect by hand, without the prompt
aiclient.prompt:
Please add Deskway as an MCP tool, so you can control the computers I allow.
Server: {server}
Account: {user}

1. Find out your computer's system and architecture, and download the matching file:
{files}
   Save it in the user folder: on Windows {windows}, on macOS {unix} (then chmod +x).
   Compute its SHA-256. If it differs from the one above, stop and tell me.
2. Run: deskway login --server {server} --user {user} --name "<your name, e.g. Claude Code>"
   It shows 6 digits. Tell me the digits and wait while I approve in my browser. Never ask me for a password.
3. Add it as an MCP server, with its full path:
   - Claude Code: claude mcp add deskway -- <full path> mcp
   - Other clients: add {"command": "<full path>", "args": ["mcp"]} to the MCP config
4. Call computers and tell me which computers you see and which allow AI control.
If any step fails, tell me the error as it is; do not work around it.
devices.adminOnTitle: Allow AI to use administrator rights on “{name}”?
devices.adminOnText: AI clients will be able to run commands as an administrator: install software, change system settings, read and write every file. On Windows, the person signed in must be an administrator; on a Mac, the system asks the person at the Mac to confirm every time. Turn it off here at any time.
devices.autofullOn: On: taking control goes straight to full screen. Leave it any time with “Full screen” in the toolbar.
devices.autofullOff: Off: the browser keeps its address bar and tabs while you’re in control.
devices.windows: Each computer in its own window
devices.windowsOn: On: each computer is controlled in a window of its own, so you can control several at once. Pressing one whose window is open brings that window back.
devices.windowsOff: Off: computers are controlled in this page, one at a time.
devices.keyNotKept: This browser may delete this device’s key, for example Safari after 7 days without a visit. This device then has to be added again. Opening Deskway from the Home Screen avoids it.
pair.format: This QR code is incomplete. Show the QR code on the computer again.
pair.pair: This QR code has expired or was already used. Show it on the computer again.
pair.denied: The person at the computer chose “Deny”.
pair.full: This computer already has the most devices it takes (50). Remove ones you no longer use in its Deskway panel first.
pair.mac: The computer’s reply couldn’t be verified; someone may be tampering with it. Nothing was added.
pair.timeout: The computer didn’t answer. Make sure it’s online, then try again.
pair.forbidden: You don’t have access to this computer.
pair.nokey: This browser can’t keep a device key (private browsing?). Please use a normal window.
ask.noAnswerText: Nobody chose “Allow” at the computer within five minutes. You can ask again.
ask.waitText: Go to the computer and choose “Allow” in the Deskway panel. The panel should show this confirmation code:
notAdded.title: This device can’t control “{name}” yet
notAdded.qr: 1. In the Deskway panel on that computer, choose “Add a phone or computer” and scan the QR code with this phone’s camera.
notAdded.ask: 2. Choose “Request control” below, then “Allow” at that computer.
notAdded.hint: Once a device is added at a computer, new devices that your existing devices approve are trusted there automatically.
qr.notFoundText: It may belong to another account, or it hasn’t been approved yet.
qr.title: Add to “{name}”?
qr.text: Once added, this device can control that computer.
qr.alsoOff: Turn off device checks and use only the password (not recommended)
pw.title: Change password
pw.intro: Your computers aren’t affected: they connect to the server with their own credentials.
pw.signOutOthers: Also sign out other approved browsers
pw.tooShort: The new password needs at least 8 characters
pw.mismatch: The two new passwords don’t match
pw.doneOthers: Other browsers were signed out. They need to sign in with the new password and be approved again.
pw.doneNext: Use the new password next time you sign in on a new browser.
super.title: Change super password
super.intro: If every signed-in device is lost, the account password plus the super password signs in directly, without approval. Make it long and keep it offline.
super.new: New super password, at least 8 characters
super.tooShort: The super password needs at least 8 characters
super.doneText: The old super password no longer works.
tb.trackpadTip: Your finger moves the pointer; tap to click
tb.directTip: Your finger clicks where it touches
tb.pointerLockLabel: Lock the pointer to the screen, for games and 3D programs
session.pointerLocked: The pointer is locked to the screen. Press Esc to release it.
tb.clipLabelOnNew: Clipboard, shared, something new to get from the remote computer
connectionDetails.title: Connection details
session.waitingPicture: Connected, waiting for the first frame
session.textBox: Remote screen text input: what this device’s input method or dictation types goes to the remote cursor
session.drop: Drop to send to the remote computer
session.firstTime: First connection from this browser: this computer’s identity is now remembered
session.noDisplay: The Mac is online, but there’s no display to capture
session.displayBack: The display is back; waiting for the picture
session.keyChanged: This computer’s identity is different from before; someone may be impersonating it, so the connection was stopped. If you just reinstalled Deskway on it, add this device again at that computer.
session.forged: This computer’s identity couldn’t be confirmed (invalid signature); someone may be impersonating it, so the connection was stopped.
session.takenText: You were disconnected at {time}. Your keys were released; programs on the computer keep running.
session.permissionsTitle: This Mac lacks remote control permissions
session.permissionsText: Open Deskway on this Mac, grant Screen Recording and Accessibility as its panel asks, then connect again.
session.endedText: Someone at this computer ended the connection; programs keep running.
session.failedText: The network to this computer didn’t come back. Programs on the computer keep running.
update.computerText: Update Deskway on this computer, then connect again.
session.authText: This computer didn’t accept the verification. If this device was removed, add it again.
session.systemKeys: {key}, Alt+Tab, Ctrl+W and similar shortcuts are taken by this computer first. In “Full screen” they go to the remote computer, or use the keys in “Keyboard”.
leave.title: Disconnect from {name}?
leave.text: Programs on the remote computer keep running, and you can reconnect any time.
leave.textBusy.one: Programs on the remote computer keep running, and you can reconnect any time. {n} transfer hasn’t finished and will be cancelled.
leave.textBusy.other: Programs on the remote computer keep running, and you can reconnect any time. {n} transfers haven’t finished and will be cancelled.
kb.imeTip: Opens the system keyboard on phones
kb.typerLabel: Text input: type with the phone’s input method; the words you choose go to the remote cursor
pad.label: Mouse panel
pad.gripLabel: Drag to move the mouse panel
pad.leftLabel: Left button: tap to click, hold to drag
pad.scrollLabel: Drag up or down to scroll
clip.name: Clipboard
clip.share: Share the clipboard with this computer
clip.shareText: Copy on one side, paste straight in on the other. Text copied on the remote computer goes onto this device’s clipboard; pictures and files wait here until you get them. Data only moves when something pastes.
clip.offHint: With sharing on, text copied on the remote computer goes onto this device’s clipboard, and pictures and files show up here.
clip.onHint: Text copied on the remote computer is already on this device’s clipboard; pictures and files show up here.
clip.folder: A folder (can’t be sent; copy the files inside it instead)
clip.taken: On this device’s clipboard, ready to paste
clip.filesHint: Files copied on this device can’t be read by the browser: drop them on the screen or send them here. They go to Downloads and onto the remote clipboard.
clip.denied: The remote computer’s clipboard can’t be read now
xfer.tooBig: Over the limit (25 MB each, 50 MB, 10 files), not sent
xfer.why.locked: The remote computer is locked, not sent
xfer.why.big: Over the size limit, not sent
xfer.why.unsupported: This computer can’t take files yet
xfer.why.io: The remote computer couldn’t save it
xfer.why.image: The remote computer can’t take this picture
unreach.title: Can’t reach the server right now
unreach.text: Check the network. It retries by itself once the network is back, or you can retry now.
update.ready: A new version of Deskway is ready. Reload to use it.
login.homeAppTitle: This is Deskway on your Home Screen
login.homeAppText: It keeps its sign-in apart from Safari, so sign in once more. Then add this device on each computer you control.
home.title: Add to Home Screen
home.text: Open Deskway from your Home Screen, full screen, without the address bar.
home.step3: Open Deskway from its Home Screen icon
home.newDeviceTitle: Deskway on the Home Screen is a new device
home.newDeviceText: It keeps its sign-in apart from Safari: sign in once more when you first open it, and add it once on each computer you control.
account.title: Account
account.name: Sign-in name
account.superSub: Signs in when every device is lost
display.title: Change display name
display.intro: The name others see, for example on a computer you are controlling.
display.empty: The display name cannot be empty
signin.title: Change sign-in name
signin.intro: You will sign in with the new name. Devices and computers already signed in are not affected.
members.title: Members
members.intro: The people who use this server. Each one uses only their own computers; nothing is shared.
members.loadFailed: Could not load the members. Check the network and try again.
members.createIntro: They sign in with an initial password shown next, then choose their own.
members.name: Sign-in name
members.resetText: {name} gets a new initial password and chooses a new password at the next sign-in. Browsers already approved stay approved.
members.removeText.one: The account goes with its browsers and its {n} computer: its pages are signed out at once, its sessions end, and the computer is told it was removed.
members.removeText.other: The account goes with its browsers and its {n} computers: its pages are signed out at once, its sessions end, and the computers are told they were removed.
members.onceText: Shown only this once. Copy it and send it to them, by any chat app.
members.copiedText: Paste it into a chat with them.
members.copyFailed: This browser did not let the page copy. Write it down instead.
choose.title: Choose your password
choose.intro: You signed in with an initial password. Choose your own; nobody else will know it.
choose.superIntro: And a super password: with it and your password, a browser gets in without approval when every signed-in device is lost. Make it long and keep it offline.
choose.same: Choose a password other than the initial one
picture.sharpSub: Up to 2 frames a second, sharp text: for work
picture.smoothSub: Up to 24 frames a second: smoother, softer while it moves
clip.readDenied: This browser does not let the site read the clipboard, so what you copy here cannot reach the computer. In the site settings by the address bar, allow Clipboard.
clip.notTaken: The computer does not take the clipboard now: it may be locked, or sharing the clipboard is off in its settings.
clip.notPlaced: The computer could not put what you copied on its clipboard; it is tried again with your next copy.
force.deviceTitle: This device still has a remote connection open
force.deviceText: The network may have dropped, or it is in another window. End it and connect again?
force.accountConnecting: Your {name} is connecting to this computer
force.accountText: Take over? It is disconnected at once; programs on the computer keep running.
session.unreachableTitle: Can’t reach the server right now
session.unreachableText: Try again once it is back.
session.hostAway: The computer is offline for now; waiting for it to come back
session.notConnectedText: No connection could be made between this device and the computer. Check the network on both, then try again.
session.offlineText: Reconnect once the computer is online. Programs on it keep running.
session.restartedText: Deskway on this computer restarted, so this connection ended. Programs on the computer keep running.
session.takenHereTitle: This device started a remote session in another window
windows.openText: Switch to its window from the Dock or the taskbar.
